status: Implemented bounded control-request sessions; no serving controller or runtime adoption
model_basis: PlacementTakeover delayed-placement composition; not full Rust refinement
behavior: One current invocation per session; prepared request owns its comparison and payload and executes one register call
Raw observations never establish confirmation; beginning or abandoning a request clears confirmation
Only the current session/invocation can install a successful response; ignored completions preserve newer local state
Abandoned calls can still apply; conflicts do not resolve earlier uncertainty; no retry after uncertain result
Every conditional call uses the shared B2/S3 fresh mutation identity, including logically unchanged revalidation
A confirmed observation records a historical successful comparison, not continuing serving permission

http_schedules: Abandoned provider operation applies before exact revalidation
Exact revalidation advances version before abandoned provider operation applies
